about_short_description.short_description: Delt.ai is building a single-stop solution for business finance management.

product.name: Revolving Corporate Credit Line
product.description: A revolving credit line for Mexican businesses to finance working capital with a 45-day payment cycle and no personal guarantees, accessible via a fully online process.

product.name: SPEI Instant Transfers
product.description: A service enabling businesses to send instant electronic fund transfers 24/7 via the SPEI system, including bulk transfers with automated processing and immediate payment receipts.

product.name: Corporate Credit Cards
product.description: Physical and virtual Mastercard corporate credit cards linked to the delt.ai credit line, designed for business expense management and team spending control.
